title: Refunds Under Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay
content:
## Refund rule

1. **Which orders.** The order value is refunded only on an order whose status is failed, cancelled or delivered, and on a delivered order only through an upheld dispute, because a delivered order of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay is not refundable other than through an upheld dispute.
2. **Failed orders.** A failed order is refunded when the customer asks, or automatically once the product's automatic-refund period, counted in calendar days after the order failed, has run. Its fees are refunded with it when the product refunds fees on failure, the fee refund being recorded with the reason "order failed".
3. **Cancelled orders.** A cancelled order is refunded in full, fees included, the fee refund being recorded with the reason "order cancelled".
4. **Timing and destination of the refund.** A refund is issued within the product's refund period in Paloma business days of becoming due, to the original payment method.
5. **Late posting.** A bill that posts later than the product's posting time in Paloma business days has its service fee refunded when the product refunds the service fee on late posting, the fee refund being recorded with the reason "late posting" — without refunding the bill.
6. **Once per basis.** Each refund basis is paid once.

The order's status is read from Paloma's records of the order. The product's automatic-refund period after failure, its refund period, and whether it refunds fees on failure or the service fee on late posting are the product's own settings.

## Refund bases at a glance

| Basis | Order status required | What is refunded | Reason recorded for any fee refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| Failed order | failed | the order value, and the fees when the product refunds fees on failure | order failed |
| Cancelled order | cancelled | the order value and the fees, in full | order cancelled |
| Upheld dispute | delivered, with the dispute upheld | the order value and the fees | — |
| Late posting of a bill | delivered (the bill has posted) | the service fee only; the bill is not refunded | late posting |

A refund of the order value closes the order, and its status becomes refunded. A late-posting refund returns the service fee only and leaves the bill paid.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical orders)

- An order whose status is submitted or processing has no refund of its order value under this rule: the value is refunded only on a failed, cancelled or delivered order.
- A delivered Paloma Airtime Top-Up order has no refund of its order value other than through an upheld dispute.
- A failed order's refund becomes due when the customer asks for it, or, when the customer does not ask, at the end of the product's automatic-refund period after the failure; either way the refund is issued within the product's refund period in Paloma business days of becoming due, to the original payment method.
- A failed order that has already been refunded on the failed-order basis is not refunded a second time on that basis.
